title: Vasopressor comparative effectiveness
summary: Candidate target-trial coordinates for comparing vasopressor strategies in ICU observational data. Treatment eligibility, assignment time, time-varying confounding, co-interventions, and positivity must be specified before estimating effects.

design_candidates.population: Patients simultaneously eligible for the compared vasopressor strategies at a reproducible treatment-decision landmark.
design_candidates.time_zero: The common treatment-eligibility and assignment time; avoid defining treatment using information after this point.
design_candidates.observation_window: Pre-treatment confounders and severity measurements available before assignment, with treatment history represented when needed.
design_candidates.prediction_or_followup_window: Follow from assignment to a prespecified mortality, organ-support, or discharge horizon with competing events defined.
eligibility_candidates: Specify active comparators and treatment grace period
Exclude only according to target-trial eligibility
design_candidates.exposure: A prespecified initiation strategy, dose strategy, or active comparator measured from the common landmark.
design_candidates.outcome: Mortality, shock resolution, or organ-support-free outcome with an explicit follow-up horizon.
design_candidates.estimand: Intention-to-treat or per-protocol contrast between clearly defined vasopressor strategies in the eligible target population.
recommended_methods: Propensity or outcome adjustment with overlap diagnostics
Time-varying methods when treatment and confounding evolve
sensitivity_analyses: Negative-control or quantitative unmeasured-confounding analysis when justified

stop_conditions: A common eligibility and treatment-assignment time cannot be identified
Key treatment timestamps or baseline severity variables are unavailable
requires_confirmation: Confirm active comparator strategies, eligibility, grace period, and time zero
Confirm whether medication non-recording can be distinguished from verified non-use
